notes:
Inbound via docs demo CTA (self-serve signup). SDR passed to AE 2024-11-05. Short discovery call 2024-11-28 (FF id above). Company building an on-site customer chat/scheduler for SMB restaurants and retailers. Wants hosted API to avoid infra ops. Key ask: vendor security paperwork up front (DPA + SOC2 evidence + list of sub-processors).

Call notes (shorthand):
- "We want to avoid any infra and just use a hosted endpoint; legal will push for DPA before POC" — Head of Ops (Maya).
- Primary POC: website chat + canned follow-ups; secondary: summarization of incoming emails.
- Latency requirement: p95 < 250ms for short queries (50-150 tokens); target 120-150ms ideal.
- Throughput: expecting bursty traffic 10-30 rps during lunch/peak; baseline 5-10 rps.
- Cost sensitivity: high — SMB budget, will prefer efficient models, interest in Redwood Optimize suggestions.
- Model preference: open to gpt-style open models and smaller quantized variants; wants routing/fallback plan (cheaper model when cost constrained).
- Data: user messages include names, email addresses, booking details — legal flags for PII. Need DPA and retention options.

Security asks captured: SOC2 scope (api/storage/console), encryption at rest, TLS in transit, KMS integration for specific fields, access logs and 90-day audit log retention option. Sub-processors requested: list of all infra providers + analytics vendors. Legal asked for redlined DPA template (can accept standard).
